name: Arch-Deployer
tagline: Bulk download Arch Linux packages and dependencies to build AppImages
description: Arch-Deployer by ivan-hc is an automated utility to bulk-download any Arch Linux package along with its full dependency tree from Arch and AUR mirrors to bundle them directly into standalone AppImages. Essential for packaging Arch-specific software into universal portable packages.
features: Recursively resolves and downloads all required Arch Linux package dependencies
Automated AppDir directory generation and ELF binary rpath patching
Compatible with both official Arch repositories and community AUR builds
Outputs ready-to-run AppImages with a single command
